description: This file defines a set of API endpoints routed via a 'Router' object for interacting with SEC filings and related data. It includes commands for retrieving filing headers, HTML content, mapping symbols to CIKs, searching institutions, schema files, symbol mapping, litigation RSS feeds, and SIC search. Each command is decorated with router.command and calls a common method to return results based on queries.

methods.name: OBBject filing_headers( cc: CommandContext, provider_choices: ProviderChoices, standard_params: StandardParams, extra_params: ExtraParams, )
methods.description: Download the index headers and cover page for an SEC filing using provided URL.

methods.name: OBBject htm_file( cc: CommandContext, provider_choices: ProviderChoices, standard_params: StandardParams, extra_params: ExtraParams, )
methods.description: Download a raw HTML object from the SEC website given a URL.

methods.name: OBBject cik_map( cc: CommandContext, provider_choices: ProviderChoices, standard_params: StandardParams, extra_params: ExtraParams, )
methods.description: Map a ticker symbol to its CIK number.

methods.name: OBBject institutions_search( cc: CommandContext, provider_choices: ProviderChoices, standard_params: StandardParams, extra_params: ExtraParams, )
methods.description: Search SEC-regulated institutions by name and return results with CIK numbers.

methods.name: OBBject schema_files( cc: CommandContext, provider_choices: ProviderChoices, standard_params: StandardParams, extra_params: ExtraParams, )
methods.description: Retrieve and navigate SEC XML schema files by directory structure.

methods.name: OBBject symbol_map( cc: CommandContext, provider_choices: ProviderChoices, standard_params: StandardParams, extra_params: ExtraParams, )
methods.description: Map a CIK number to a ticker symbol.

methods.name: OBBject rss_litigation( cc: CommandContext, provider_choices: ProviderChoices, standard_params: StandardParams, extra_params: ExtraParams, )
methods.description: Get RSS feed of litigation releases concerning civil lawsuits.

methods.name: OBBject sic_search( cc: CommandContext, provider_choices: ProviderChoices, standard_params: StandardParams, extra_params: ExtraParams, )
methods.description: Search for Industry Titles, Reporting Office, and SIC codes.
